items.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18
items.q: LeBlanc, you know, made Haddock Hall there.

ctx.x: Yeah. It's a medicine show. Real, I mean, it was a real fine. Well, in, in those days, uh, you'd compare almost, uh, Dr. Moon's medicine show with that one LeBlanc had. Uh-huh. LeBlanc didn't have nothing but a medicine show, but it was really a big one. But, Dr. Moon had a, had a big special-made bus at that time. Uh, probably cost about, uh, $30,000. Yeah. Yeah. We had those vats on there that we could mix that medicine in.
You mean a bus that, uh, a real, you know, was...
